CustomField.description: Picto list representing the plaforms size 48 pix (list view purpose)
CustomField.formula: TRIM( IF(ISBLANK(Text(Status__c)),'',IMAGE('/resource/accountStatus/'+Text(Status__c)+'.svg',Text(Status__c), 48, 48)) + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_1__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/1'+IF(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'active')),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_1__c, 48, 48)) + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_2__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/2'+IF(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'active')),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_2__c, 48, 48)) + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_3__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/3'+IF(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'active')),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_3__c, 48, 48)) + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_4__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/4'+IF(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'active')),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_4__c, 48, 48)) + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_5__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/5'+IF(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'active')),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_5__c, 48, 48)) + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_6__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/6'+IF(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'active')),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_6__c, 48, 48)) )
CustomField.label: Health (48)
